means: Every board of harddrop's DPC Setups page and its five Extra DPC Setups pages, parsed from pinned MediaWiki revisions; each board drawing the T placed on a board built from empty is a setup. Quarantined: no claim ids, no badges.

source.terms: not stated; every page credits by link
source.fetched: 2026-10-23, through a fetch service (this sandbox cannot reach harddrop.com); MediaWiki's revision sha1 equals the sha1 of the bytes read

index_page.title: Extra DPC Setups
index_page.note: links the five Extra pages; its example boards repeat theirs and are not transcribed (its sha1 is recorded under sha1_at_read, not revision_sha1, because nothing re-reads it)

source.definition: When you do a perfect-clear loop that takes 8 lines to complete, such as First-Second perfect clear, [[SingleYou]] or [[Mountainous Stacking]], you will be left with an empty board and an extra piece. A DPC setup will use the extra piece and 2 bags to create a T-Spin and a perfect clear, bringing you back to the beginning with no extra pieces, to continue the loop.
